## Proto781M's Better Spawn 1.0.2 for Minecraft 1.21.11

### Changes

- Added a shared Brigadier command builder for the optional `[pos] [angle] [dimension]`
  command chain, including dimension suggestions for all setter commands.
- Ported the command, respawn, saved-data, NBT, and teleport layers to NeoForge 21.11.48
  and Minecraft 1.21.11.
- Updated the mod logo, metadata, and PolyForm Noncommercial license packaging.

### Install

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- NeoForge 21.11.48+
- Java 21
- Put `betterspawn-1.0.2+1.21.11.jar` in the `mods` directory.

### Documentation

- Wiki: https://github.com/Nacano12345/MyBetterSpawnMod/wiki
